---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, month_num) |>
  arrange(month_num)
```

```{r}
summary(mallards$speed)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(!is.na(speed), speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month)) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(mallards$month))) +
  labs(x = "Speed (m/s)", y = "Month")
```
